t: The Brenner Hand Soap is a liquid hand wash designed for effective everyday cleaning. This 0.5 Ltr bottle is ideal for busy trade environments, including workshops, site cabins, and domestic kitchens. The mild formula removes stubborn dirt while integrated moisturising ingredients prevent dry skin from frequent washing. A light, fresh fragrance ensures hands feel clean and conditioned after use, offering practical hygiene for plumbers, builders, and mechanics.
b: Moisturisers Help Stop Hands Feeling Dry
Mild Fragrance Leaves Hands Smelling Clean
